parameters.name: BranchId
parameters.description: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

parameters.name: ClearExpiresAt
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to clear the branch expiration time.

Valid values:
- true: Clears ExpiresAt.
- false: Does not clear ExpiresAt.

If this parameter is not specified, the existing expiration time remains unchanged.

parameters.name: ExpiresAt
parameters.description: The time when the branch automatically expires and is deleted. The value is in ISO 8601 UTC format.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the primary branch.

parameters.name: Protected
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable branch protection.

Valid values:
- true: Branch protection is enabled.
- false: Branch protection is disabled. This is the default value.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, the region of the primary branch is inherited by default.
